actions.script: const check = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.maintenance.AccessServices.check#Record') .parameters({appRoot, recordType: 'workOrder', recordId: workEffortId}).requireNewTransaction(true).call() || {} let detail = null if (!ec.message.hasError() && check.recordId) detail = ec.service.sync().name('mantle.work.MaintenanceServices.get#MaintenanceWorkOrder').parameters({workEffortId}).call() || null ec.message.clearErrors() const order = (detail && detail.workOrder) || null ec.web.sendJsonResponse(!order ? {found: false} : {found: true, workEffortId, name: order.workEffortName || workEffortId, customerName: (order.repair && order.repair.customerName) || '', repair: !!order.repair, plannedEnd: order.estimatedCompletionDate ? ec.user.timestampMillis(order.estimatedCompletionDate) : null, plannedEndText: order.estimatedCompletionText || ''})

render-mode.text: [{"t": "text", "id": "MaintenanceShareLocation", "text": "Share your location with the customer from the app or a browser: the terminal has no position to send."}]
